title: parity gate detail and safe slice

commit.merge_subject: merge: parity gate detail and safe slice

description:
The parity run measures SHADER MATH, not resolution — but it ran
on the FULL frame, so the verdict was clip-size-dependent (a
future 8K clip could OOM the gate at every export start) and
the gate paid full-frame cost whether the clip needed it or not.

developFragmentParity now slices oversized frames to a fixed
budget before running the harness:

- A frame whose long edge fits 2048 passes through WHOLE, no
  copy — the device-proven full-frame runs keep their exact
  shape and verdict.
- A larger frame runs as a CENTER CROP: even offsets and even
  dimensions (the crop starts on a 2x2 cell boundary and spans
  whole cells), so the CFA pattern alignment and cellFor's
  layout stay valid — an RGGB crop of an RGGB frame.
- The cropped CFA is a new vector; a sliced FrameInfo copies
  every other field verbatim (developLinear/developCpu read no
  other geometry — activeArea is DngWriter-only
changed: feat: parity runs at a fixed safe slice
